skill.name: wan-2-7
skill.description: Generate short Wan 2.7 videos through RunComfy. This skill documents setup, model inputs, lip-sync audio, prompt guidance, output limits, and CLI invocation.
skill.summary: Create short Wan 2.7 text-to-video clips with RunComfy CLI guidance.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown backticks, field names, and example fences. Confirmed risks remain because the skill intentionally uses local CLI commands, package installation, and RunComfy network submission. No evidence found of prompt injection, covert malware behavior, or system reconnaissance in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: External CLI commands can run package and generation workflows on the user machine.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before npm, npx, login, or runcomfy commands, and show the full command first.

remediation.issue: Generation requests send prompts and media references to a third-party model API.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to include secrets, private media, or confidential campaign data unless they approve the transfer.

remediation.issue: The setup guidance recommends global package installation.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer pinned package versions or a local project install where possible, and document the trusted package source.

remediation.issue: RunComfy login can persist an API token in the local user configuration.
remediation.suggestion: Document token cleanup, file permissions, and the RUNCOMFY_TOKEN option for ephemeral environments.

content.value_statement: Teams need a repeatable way to create short Wan 2.7 videos without rebuilding CLI arguments. This skill explains setup, inputs, prompt patterns, and safer RunComfy invocation choices.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to choose Wan 2.7 instead of related video models.
Documents required and optional inputs, including prompt, audio_url, duration, resolution, and aspect ratio.
Shows RunComfy CLI invocation patterns for default, lip-synced, and literal-control runs.
Lists prompt guidance for camera motion, negative prompts, prompt expansion, and seed iteration.
Summarizes model limits, exit codes, endpoints, token storage, and output download behavior.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account and local RunComfy CLI before generation can run.
Generated clips are limited to documented Wan 2.7 duration, resolution, aspect ratio, and audio constraints.
Prompts, audio URLs, and media references are sent to RunComfy services.
It does not create longer videos, native 4K output, or in-pass voice generation.

use_cases.title: Create Lip-Synced Ads
use_cases.description: Build short product or spokesperson clips that use a supplied audio track for lip-sync timing.

use_cases.title: Produce Dub Variants
use_cases.description: Reuse a core scene prompt with different audio URLs for language or market variants.

use_cases.title: Prototype Motion Prompts
use_cases.description: Test camera moves, aspect ratios, prompt expansion, and seed choices before a final production run.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Clip Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-second Wan 2.7 video prompt for [product or scene]. Use 16:9, 1080p, and one clear camera movement.

prompt_templates.title: Platform Short Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a vertical Wan 2.7 clip for [platform]. Include aspect ratio, duration, motion, negative prompt guidance, and likely output limits.

prompt_templates.title: Lip-Sync Request Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Check a supplied audio track before generation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a lip-synced spokesperson request for Wan 2.7 using my audio URL: [URL]. Check duration, format, aspect ratio, and prompt clarity.

prompt_templates.title: Model Route Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose between Wan 2.7 and related video models.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Wan 2.7 with HappyHorse, Seedance, Kling, and LTX for this video goal: [goal]. Recommend the best route and explain tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: Request: Create a short product showcase video for a premium skincare bottle.
output_examples.output: A polished Wan 2.7 prompt with camera motion, studio lighting, duration, aspect ratio, and negative prompt guidance.

output_examples.input: Request: Make a vertical lip-synced founder message from a supplied voiceover.
output_examples.output: A generation plan that checks audio length, recommends 9:16 framing, and describes stable camera and lighting choices.

output_examples.input: Request: Decide whether Wan 2.7 is the right model for a fast concept test.
output_examples.output: A concise routing recommendation that compares model strengths, speed needs, audio needs, and output limits.

best_practices: Use one primary action per clip so motion remains clear.
Confirm audio length, format, and file size before using lip-sync.
Review the exact command and output directory before running the CLI.
anti_patterns: Do not include secrets, private media URLs, or unreleased campaign details in prompts.
Do not ask for many unrelated actions in one short clip.
Do not rely on vague negative prompts such as poor quality or bad colors.

faq.question: What does this skill help generate?
faq.answer: It helps generate short Wan 2.7 text-to-video clips through the RunComfy CLI.

faq.question: Does it require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow requires the RunComfy CLI and an authenticated RunComfy account.

faq.question: Can it create lip-synced videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents the audio_url option and the related duration, size, and format limits.

faq.question: Can it create 4K or long videos?
faq.answer: No. The skill documents a 1080p ceiling and a short duration range for Wan 2.7.

faq.question: Where does user content go?
faq.answer: Prompts and media references are submitted to RunComfy services when the CLI command runs.

faq.question: Is it safe to run automatically?
faq.answer: No. The workflow uses external commands and a third-party API, so users should confirm each run.
